risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (396.64), flat yield curve, and rising dollar create severe headwinds for international equities; macro score of -4 confirms highly unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/PPO crossovers and three white soldiers pattern signal emerging momentum, while extreme fear (10/100) and heavy bearish AAII bias (49%) create classic contrarian capitulation setup near support.
